author: mark
text:
v0.3.1 gate: tests + coverage + steps layout + JSONL response

Pre-close audit for bl-cec0 contract regression.

- cargo test --workspace: 472 tests pass, 0 failures
- cargo tarpaulin --fail-under 100: 100.00% (2203/2203 lines)
- lernie new produces conv-repo with steps/ at the conv-repo root
  and no steps/ tree under any worktree (verified against fresh
  scratch repo)
- lernie prompt against stub provider adapter writes
  response.json as JSONL — 5 §4.4 events, one JSON object per line
  (message_start, content_block_start, text_delta,
  content_block_stop, message_stop)

No code changes: this is a verification gate.
